  ✓ brief   ⊘ questions   ● draft

  test-writer — adds table-driven tests for a package and r…

  ⚠ Commands is as it was — allow: a profile carries no
    allowlist — a file that lets commands run without asking
    would be a file granting them, and only your own
    settings or a card may; a profile can only add to what
    is refused, with deny
